meta.descricao: The cell of the Political Education School: agenda, who does what, study circle, assembly and step review. Members only.

tela.semNucleo: The coordination assigns each member to a cell. Meanwhile, the facilitator's kit and the assembly are already here.
tela.alumia: The cell's conversations and actions live on Alumia.
tela.ausente: The School's cell has not reached this installation yet. For now, organise through the cell on Alumia.
tela.previa: Development preview: sample data, nothing here is real.

pauta.vazia: The agenda is still blank. The facilitators put it together; you can bring a topic below.
pauta.levado: brought by someone in the cell
pauta.repete: You did this one at the last circle: leave it for someone else.
pauta.semTarefas: No tasks yet. The circle's next steps go here, in rotation.
pauta.presenca: Attendance at the last {n} circles: {lista} people.
pauta.semPresenca: Attendance shows up here after the first circles (only the number, never the names).

tarefas.texto: Every next step has someone who takes it. Rotation: whoever did a task at the last circle leaves it for someone else, so everyone learns to do everything.
tarefas.nenhumaMinha: You have not taken any task from this meeting.

levar.texto: A question, an idea, something from the neighbourhood: it goes on the next meeting's agenda, without your name.
levar.ok: Added to the next meeting's agenda, without your name.

pergunta.texto: As in Paulo Freire's culture circle: a question drawn from the learners' own lives opens the circle. Think about your answer and bring it to the cell.
pergunta.vazia: The coordination has not set this week's question yet.
pergunta.rotulo: Your answer, to bring to the circle (up to 200 characters)
pergunta.enviar: Bring the answer to the circle

mediar.so: Only the cell's facilitators and the coordination see this.
mediar.balancoRotulo: Review: what we saw, what we thought, what we will do (no names)
mediar.recadosNota: Members of the cell see them until the chosen date. Notices for the whole School go through the coordination.

kit.lead: A guide for the cell's circle in see-judge-act, opened and closed by the mística. The facilitator changes at every meeting (rotation).
pautaModelo: See: what happened this week and in the task in the world
Act: next steps and who does what

misticaAbertura.texto: A shared moment before the conversation: a song, a poem, a photo or object from local struggles, a passage from the workbook read aloud. It reminds everyone why the cell exists.
misticaAbertura.dica: Agree at the previous circle on who prepares it. No audience: everyone takes part.

ver.texto: Each person tells what they saw: the task in the world, the difficult conversation, what happened in the neighbourhood, at school, at work. The question of the week opens this part.
ver.dica: Talk about situations, not people: no names of third parties.

julgar.texto: The cell rereads what was shared in the light of the workbook: why does this happen? who wins and who loses? what does the workbook help us understand?
julgar.dica: The facilitator asks more than answers.

agir.texto: Concrete next steps: what we will do, by when and who takes it. Each task goes on the "Who does what" list.
agir.dica: Rotation: whoever took a task at the last circle leaves it for someone else.

misticaFechamento.texto: Close together: one word from each person about the meeting, a song, the next steps read aloud.
misticaFechamento.dica: Afterwards, the facilitator records attendance (only the number) and the review, without names.

sistematizar.texto: The circle's review keeps the cell's memory: what we saw, what we thought, what we decided. With nobody's name, so it can be read by whoever joins later.

kit.circuloTexto: The facilitator's tool: generative words, theme, questions and lessons for the meeting, stored only on this device.

banca.texto: To close a step, the person presents to the cell what they studied and the task in the world they carried out. The review panel makes a collective assessment, with no grade: what the person brought, what the cell saw, what carries over to the next step.
passos: The person's mentor schedules the review with them.
On the day, the person tells the story of their step (10 min).
The cell asks and comments, without judging the person (15 min).
The mentor records the collective assessment: "step opened" or "agree again".
banca.fichaTitulo: Feedback form by competence (on this device)

banca.titulo: Your mentor and the step review
banca.semAcompanha: Nobody is accompanying your education yet. The coordination assigns someone from Step 3.
banca.semMinhas: No review scheduled for you yet.
banca.marcarQuando: Date and time of the review (optional)
banca.balancoRotulo: Collective assessment, no grade (10 to 2000 characters)

assembleia.texto: The assembly votes on the semester's study agenda. The vote is anonymous: the server only adds up.
assembleia.semPauta: No agenda open for voting right now.
assembleia.roteiroTitulo: Holding the assembly in the cell

erros.rodizio: You did this task at the last circle. Leave it for someone else.
erros.ja_tem_quem: Someone has already taken this task.
erros.sem_nucleo: You are not in a cell yet.
erros.sem_encontro: There is no meeting scheduled to bring the topic to.
erros.pauta_cheia: The next meeting's agenda already has 12 items.
erros.sem_permissao: This is not available to your account.
erros.banca_ja_marcada: A review is already scheduled for this person.
erros.banca_ja_decidida: This review already has an assessment.
erros.acompanhante_degrau_3: Only someone from Step 3 can accompany.
erros.muitas_tentativas: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a little.
erros.ausente: This part has not reached this installation yet.
erros.falha: That did not work right now. Try again.

painel.lead: The Political Education School by Alumia codename: nobody appears here by legal name or e-mail. Who enters the School is decided in People: adding the person to the Revolutionaries department opens the School to them; removing them deletes what the School stored.

pergunta.texto: One question a week, drawn from the learners' lives. It shows on the Today screen and opens the cell's circle. Empty text deletes the week's question.

recados.texto: They show on the Today screen until the chosen date. For the whole School, or for one cell only.

nucleos.texto: The cells come from Alumia; each cell's facilitators prepare the School meetings. Place each member in a cell on the Members tab.

painel.limite: Honest limit: the panel only shows the codename confirmed on Alumia. Whoever has not chosen a codename yet appears as "no codename".
